manifest.public_domain_basis: Own transcription of a printed edition published in 1909 (Anandashram Sanskrit Series no. 34, Pune); editor Hari Narayan Apte died 3 March 1919, so the edition is public domain in India and the US. The verse text is read from page images; no modern edition's text, selection or translation is used.
manifest.permission_proof: Rights basis accepted by the Pramana project owner on 2026-10-15 after checking the editor's death date (1919). Method: docs/gita-pilot/scan-extraction.md and docs/gita-pilot/transcription/README.md. Title-page contributors other than Apte not yet confirmed.

sources.title: Srimad Bhagavadgita with Shankara bhashya and Anandagiri tika
sources.author: Hari Narayan Apte (ed.)

reviewers: Pramana project owner (approved release without verse-by-verse review)
